verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Grafana CLI with first-party documentation. The observability-as-code docs say it handles authentication, multiple environments, and admin tasks from the terminal, and suits CI/CD pipelines. The evidence does not show the CLI is built for AI-native or agentic use, so coverage of the story is partial. missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output, agent workflows), detailed command reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can authenticate, manage multiple environments, and perform administrative tasks from the terminal. It’s suitable for CI/CD pipelines, local development
